pinterest.title: Paros Wedding Venues in the North: A Chapel Courtyard Among Olive Trees Above Kolymbithres
pinterest.description: On the north coast of Paros, Petra Farm sits high above the bay of Kolymbithres, looking across to Naoussa. Ceremonies take place in the chapel's courtyard among the olive trees; the chapel holds 120 guests and the event space fits 150 with a dance floor. Nearby, Astir of Paros has the St. Nicholas chapel right by the water. Compare eight Paros wedding venues across three parts of the island, and see how to get married there.

pinterest.title: Paros Wedding Venues With Exclusive Use: Four Villas Above the Bay of Parikia
pinterest.description: Villa Mira Paros is a group of four villas perched high above the Bay of Parikia, with panoramic views of the Aegean and a central pool. You can book the entire property for your day, with a shared barbecue and pool area, so ask how many guests the four villas sleep. On the same side of the island, Pyrgaki Hotel offers its St. George chapel or the Byzantine One Hundred Doors church in Parikia. Compare eight Paros wedding venues.

pinterest.title: Paros Wedding Venues Above Golden Beach: A Symbolic Ceremony With an Aegean View
pinterest.description: The Secret View sits on a family estate in the hills above Golden Beach. A traditional Greek chapel is the backdrop for a symbolic ceremony, and the Terrace takes up to 110 for a ceremony and 120 for dinner. Couples have full access to every area for 24 hours, and the covered Pergola is built for a drizzle or the heat. There are no rooms, so guests stay nearby, and the venue says it is happy to organise shuttles. Compare eight Paros wedding venues.

slides: 8 Paros wedding venues across three parts of the island. Choose the area first: it shapes your ceremony, your view and where your guests sleep.
Naoussa and the north: Astir of Paros has the St. Nicholas chapel right by the water at Kolymbithres, and Anemoi Paros holds ceremonies in its own Chapel of St. John above Naoussa bay.
Also in the north: Petra Farm, an organic farm above Kolymbithres bay, with ceremonies in the chapel courtyard among olive trees, and Monastiri, with vows on a sandy beach in Paros Park.
Parikia and the west: Pyrgaki Hotel offers its St. George chapel or the One Hundred Doors church in Parikia, and Villa Mira Paros can be booked as a whole property for your day.
Golden Beach and the east coast: Poseidon of Paros has a chapel, with receptions by the pool or on the beach. The Secret View, in the hills above, offers a symbolic ceremony with a view.
Ask which ceremony each chapel takes. Six of the eight venues have a chapel, but only The Secret View names a ceremony type. Decide early whether yours is a legal marriage or a symbolic one.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Which part of Paros suits your wedding?

Paros wedding venues sit in three parts of the island: Naoussa and the bays of the north coast, Parikia and the hills above its gulf in the west, and Golden Beach on the east coast.

Our new guide sets out eight venues across those areas, each on the same terms: setting, ceremony, published capacity, rooms and exclusive use. It is not a ranking.

The short version: for a chapel, a garden and a harbour village for the days around the wedding, start in the north. For a view over the water and a base near the port where ferry guests arrive, look west. For a beachfront hotel or an estate in the hills, look east. Paros is a chapel island, but most venues do not publish which ceremony their chapel takes, so ask before you fall for the setting.

The guide also covers how to get married on Paros: decide early whether the ceremony will be your legal marriage or a celebration of one, and check the steps with the Municipality of Paros and the Australian Embassy in Athens before you book. For a summer date, plan shade, a later ceremony and a covered fallback, as Greece has frequent heatwaves in summer and a wildfire season from June to September.

Shortlisting Paros venues for your own wedding? Send us a message with your date, guest count and the venues you have in mind, and a Wedded Advisor will help you compare them. Your advisor works in your time zone, quotes in AUD and confirms every inclusion in writing before you commit. Full guide at the link in our bio.
